links.outcome: AI model accuracy, sensitivity, specificity versus human gatekeepers against physician consensus standard
links.effect: AI had higher accuracy and specificity and lower sensitivity than current human gatekeeper approach; AI accuracy 0.716, sensitivity 0.542, specificity 0.801.
links.quote: When compared against the consensus standard, the AI model had higher accuracy and specificity and lower sensitivity than the current approach.
Regarding individual specialties, rheumatology exhibited the highest accuracy (0.811; 95% IC, 0.767-0.849), while proctology had the lowest (0.649; 95% IC, 0.597-0.697).

unlisted_practices: AI triage of specialty referrals (gatekeeping) combined with human judgment

screen.reason: Retrospective diagnostic study developing and evaluating an NLP/neural network model for referral triage/gatekeeping against a physician consensus standard and historical human gatekeepers.
